name: Winter
description: Winter is a pale, spiky-haired survivor who has lived in the Duskmourn house most of his life and later appears as the leader of the Speed Demons racers in Aetherdrift.

summary.text: Winter is a pale, spiky-haired survivor who has lived in the Duskmourn house most of his life and later appears as the leader of the Speed Demons racers in Aetherdrift.

bio.text: Winter lured a razorkin into a beartrap and led Niko and the Wanderer to safety, then agreed to guide them through the House.
He explained the House's tricks, including razorkin, glimmers and glitch ghosts, and revealed that he had come through a door years ago with his best friend, who was now gone.
In the Valley of Serenity he warned of the Cult of Valgavoth and then dropped a granite slab that sealed the others in with the cultists.

Niko deduced that Winter had sacrificed his best friend to Valgavoth, who had promised his heart's desire in exchange for four lives, and Niko sealed him in a shard as he tried the door a third time, after which Valgavoth took him.
In Aetherdrift he raced as leader of the Speed Demons, bound to a demon who told him to bring the Aetherspark or belong to the House, and he kept the creature Loot caged.
He clashed with Chandra and Spitfire, was pulled from his wrecked vehicle by Vraska, and was taken prisoner by Jace.
Trying to cross the finish line on foot with a broken leg, he was dragged back to hell through a door.

status.text: In the latest story Winter is dragged back to hell through a door as the Amonkheti win the race.

timeline.summary: A stranger yanks Niko and the Wanderer behind a hanging carcass, just before a masked figure appears.
timeline.quote: yanked them hard behind the nearest hanging, flensed behemoth

timeline.summary: A tall razorkin with a cleaver stalks through the carcasses toward them.
timeline.quote: a figure came stalking through the carcasses, tall and wiry.

timeline.summary: Winter lures the razorkin into a beartrap by rattling a chain and leads Niko and the Wanderer out.
timeline.quote: only to step into a beartrap that had been concealed by the fog on the floor.

timeline.summary: Winter explains razorkin from the Floodpits track sound and that fighting one head-on would lose.
timeline.quote: The ones you find in the Floodpits aren't used to hearing sounds not echoed through water.

timeline.summary: Winter tells them he has lived in the House most of his life and that the House is the whole world.
timeline.quote: The House is the world, and the world is the House, and once it has hold of you, there's nowhere else to go.

timeline.summary: Winter stops Niko and the Wanderer from stepping on the moths woven into the carpet.
timeline.quote: Don't step on any of the moths!

timeline.summary: Winter explains that the door they came through was a lure and that Duskmourn now holds them.
timeline.quote: But when you tried to turn around and go, the door wasn't there anymore.

timeline.summary: The Wanderer tells Winter they came to find a lost child, Nashi.
timeline.quote: We came seeking a child who has been lost

timeline.summary: The Wanderer draws her sword on Winter and warns him not to taunt them.
timeline.quote: Her sword, which had been belted at her hip, was suddenly in her hands, the blade only inches from Winter's face.

timeline.summary: Winter explains that the House splits groups to isolate and frighten them.
timeline.quote: That's Duskmourn, splitting you from your friends

timeline.summary: Winter reveals that razorkin are rebuilt survivors the House beguiles into slaughterhouse skins.
timeline.quote: Duskmourn repairs and rebuilds the people it takes, the same way an upholsterer might re-cover a couch.

timeline.summary: Winter points out the Wanderer's glimmer, a golden dragon of light; she reacts as if to Kyodai but recognizes it is not.
timeline.quote: There, floating several feet above the parlor floor, hovered a golden dragon etched entirely of light

timeline.summary: Winter explains that everyone in Duskmourn has a glimmer; Niko asks where theirs is.
timeline.quote: Everyone in Duskmourn has one.

timeline.summary: The glimmer leads the group through a doorway on a safe path.
timeline.quote: the glimmer began to swim through the air to a doorway on the far wall.

timeline.summary: The glimmer of Kyodai leads Winter, Niko and the Wanderer through the House, ignored by its horrors.
timeline.quote: The gleaming golden shadow of Kyodai led them onward

timeline.summary: Winter explains that glitch ghosts enter the House through reflective surfaces.
timeline.quote: They use reflective surfaces to enter the House.

timeline.summary: A glitch ghost drags itself from a mirror toward Niko.
timeline.quote: a shuddering entity began to drag itself from the mirror frame

timeline.summary: Niko traps the glitch ghost inside a magical shard, which Winter had thought impossible.
timeline.quote: The shard hit the entity, and the entity was gone, while the shard remained

timeline.summary: Winter is stunned that Niko can defeat a ghost without a ghost-catcher.
timeline.quote: What you just did isn't possible!

timeline.summary: Winter tells the Wanderer that the House has taken the whole outside, leaving everything inside.
timeline.quote: There's no outside left.

timeline.summary: The group discovers a clearing where wickerfolk dance around a cold fire next to cages of nezumi captives.
timeline.quote: There were seven in all, four of them occupied by humanoid rats

timeline.summary: The Wanderer uses Winter's lighter to ignite grass and drive the wickerfolk into the woods.
timeline.quote: A tiny flame shot out, and the grass lit up, burning like a beacon.

timeline.summary: Winter reveals he came through a door years ago with his best friend, who is now gone.
timeline.quote: My best friend and I, we walked through one of those doors years ago.

timeline.summary: Winter warns that they have entered the Valley of Serenity, home of the Cult of Valgavoth; Nashi insists on continuing.
timeline.quote: The Cult of Valgavoth lives here.

timeline.summary: Winter explains the cult's belief and that it captures survivors to convert or feed to Valgavoth.
timeline.quote: They claim Duskmourn was created by an entity summoned by their ancestors

timeline.summary: The party enters a cavern of robed cultists who hold three bound survivors and hang chrysalises.
timeline.quote: Half a dozen humanoid figures in long robes shaped like moth's wings

timeline.summary: Cultists seize the Wanderer, Nashi and Niko while Winter bows his head and does not resist.
timeline.quote: Winter only bowed his head, saying nothing, as the cultists rose up and grabbed Niko in turn.

timeline.summary: Winter drops a granite slab that seals the others in with the cultists.
timeline.quote: A slab of solid granite crashed down between him and the others, sealing them in the room with the cultists.

timeline.summary: Niko feels betrayed by Winter, their only ally in the House.
timeline.quote: they had been betrayed by their only ally inside the House

timeline.summary: Valgavoth reveals himself as an enormous moth-demon melded into the wall and the cultists kneel.
timeline.quote: what appeared to be an enormous moth spun from the fabric of nightmares

timeline.summary: Valgavoth tells Winter he promised his heart's desire in exchange for four lives.
timeline.quote: Four lives to secure your heart's desire. Four thresholds for me to cross.

timeline.summary: Niko deduces that Winter sacrificed his best friend to Valgavoth.
timeline.quote: You sacrificed her to a monster for your own heart's desire.

timeline.summary: Winter says he gave everything and asks to be let go.
timeline.quote: I gave everything. Now let me go.

timeline.summary: Valgavoth opens a door in his body and promises Winter he may leave; Winter falls as he runs.
timeline.quote: When he folded them again, there was a door set in the base of his body

timeline.summary: Niko seals Winter in a shard as he tries the door a third time.
timeline.quote: one of Niko's shards to hit him squarely in the back and envelop him, sealing him away from the freedom he'd so craved

timeline.summary: Valgavoth takes Winter and melts into the ceiling with him.
timeline.quote: Pulling Winter higher to his leaking, punctured chest, Valgavoth melted into the ceiling

timeline.summary: Winter studies Chandra on a screen while ghouls work on his racer and a demon stares at him.
timeline.quote: He just needs to study her—her and all the other racers.

timeline.summary: A demon tells Winter to bring the Aetherspark or belong to the House.
timeline.quote: Bring us the Aetherspark, and you're free. Fail, and you belong to the House.

timeline.summary: Chandra hears a caged creature crying and finds it among Winter's vehicles and ghouls.
timeline.quote: The cage itself is so small that the creature is forced to stand on its hind legs at all times.

timeline.summary: Winter warns Chandra off, threatening she will end up last with six pallbearers.
timeline.quote: Chronic-hero syndrome gets you last place and six pallbearers.

timeline.summary: Chandra heats and bends the cage bars to give the creature a perch.
timeline.quote: She pulls two of the bars apart wide enough to make a little perch for the creature.

timeline.summary: Chandra confronts Winter, who answers that those old enough to race are old enough to die.
timeline.quote: If they're old enough to race, they're old enough to die.

timeline.summary: Blue flame engulfs Winter and the demon roars.
timeline.quote: This time, blue flames sear through Winter's skin.

timeline.summary: Chandra hurls a fireball that sends the Speed Demons spinning into a dune.
timeline.quote: Chandra hurls the fireball so hard that only a desperate grab for the handle keeps her from becoming a bright orange smear against the pavement.

timeline.summary: The caged creature yelps when the fireball hits the Speed Demons, leaving Chandra uneasy.
timeline.quote: When her fireball hit the Speed Demons, the little guy in the cage yelped.

timeline.summary: Emerging in first, Chandra sees Winter ahead of her again.
timeline.quote: Winter is somehow right up ahead of her.

timeline.summary: A raider's hook tears Loot's cage from Winter's vehicle and drops Loot into a sack.
timeline.quote: Momentum and angles combine to tear the hook free—and the cage along with it.

timeline.summary: Spitfire races through the Omenpath into Ghirapur, leading the field to the finish.
timeline.quote: As her ride howls through the Omenpath, there is nothing to hamper her.

timeline.summary: Spitfire and Winter go chassis to chassis near the finish.
timeline.quote: The Aether Ranger's front bumper scrapes against the Speed Demon's driver-side door.

timeline.summary: Winter fires blue flame at Spitfire and bursts into flame.
timeline.quote: Winter shoots a gout of blue flame at her.

timeline.summary: A golden filigree safety wall shoots up in the track, ahead of the finish line.
timeline.quote: Shooting up in the middle of the track is an intricate wall of golden filigree

timeline.summary: Vraska pulls Winter from the Speed Demons' wreck.
timeline.quote: Vraska tears Winter from the wreckage.

timeline.summary: Jace compels Winter to go limp and searches his mind for Loot.
timeline.quote: With another wave of his hand, Jace compels him to go limp.

timeline.summary: Jace decides to take Winter prisoner as a loose end.
timeline.quote: I think we need to take him prisoner.

timeline.summary: Chandra realizes Winter used Loot to find secret Omenpaths as shortcuts.
timeline.quote: He made you show him where the other Omenpaths are, the ones nobody else knows about.

timeline.summary: Winter, with a broken leg, tries to cross the undefended finish line on foot.
timeline.quote: The rules don't say anything about crossing the finish line on foot.

timeline.summary: A door appears and Winter is dragged back to hell as the Amonkheti win.
timeline.quote: But they will make no mention of the man so close to victory dragged with awful finality back to hell.

relations.note: Niko offers to take Winter out of the House.
Struck a bargain with Winter for four sacrifices in exchange for freedom.
relations.quote: I promised you your heart's desire

relations.note: Niko seals Winter in a shard after learning of his betrayal.
relations.quote: one of Niko's shards to hit him squarely in the back and envelop him

relations.note: She calls him out for terrorizing the others.
relations.quote: Pick on somebody your own age, Winter!

pages_say.description: A pale, spiky-haired survivor who has lived in the House most of his life and rescues Niko and the Wanderer from a razorkin.
A scrawny survivor who dresses in wallpaper strips, knows the House's tricks and agrees to guide Niko and the Wanderer.
A survivor who came through a door with his best friend years ago and guides Niko and the Wanderer.
A survivor guide who warns of the Cult of Valgavoth and then drops a granite slab to seal the others in with the cultists.
A survivor who admits he sacrificed his best friend to Valgavoth for his heart's desire, and is taken by Valgavoth.
A haggard racer who studies the other racers and is bound to a demon that demands the Aetherspark in exchange for his freedom.
A gaunt, exhausted team leader who keeps a fuzzy creature in a tiny cage and drives ghoul-built vehicles.
A racer who commands the Speed Demons, burns with blue flame and keeps a caged creature.
The Speed Demons leader who keeps Loot caged and swerves so that raiders tear the cage free.
Captain of the Speed Demons, who races Spitfire and is captured by Vraska and Jace.
A racer who tries to reach the finish line on a broken leg and is dragged back to hell.
